$comment: TP-Link Tapo cameras: their settings over the camera's own HTTPS API, with the Tapo ACCOUNT password used locally (pattern P4, no cloud). Video: #43. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: Tapo camera
description: TP-Link Tapo cameras (C100, C200, C210, C310, ...): pictures, privacy mode, motion detection, alarm, status light, night vision.

inputs.label: Camera address
inputs.hint: The Tapo app shows it under the camera's Device Info, e.g. 192.168.1.133

inputs.label: Camera Account user name (for video)
inputs.hint: Optional: set in the Tapo app, Camera Settings > Advanced Settings > Camera Account. Without it: settings only, no pictures.

inputs.label: Camera Account password
inputs.hint: Optional, with the user name above

inputs.label: Tapo account password
inputs.hint: The password of the Tapo app account the camera belongs to (not the 'Camera Account' for video). It stays on the hub: the camera checks it on your network.

errors.refused: {message}. Use the Tapo app account's password (not the Camera Account's). After 10 wrong tries the camera locks logins for 30 minutes.
errors.unreachable: The hub can't reach the camera. Is it on, and on the same network?
